description: Ground truth temporal interval annotations for dynamic formation structure (EXP-21) across 12 SoccerNet tracking clips

definitions.4-2-3-1: 4 defenders, 2 defensive midfielders, 3 attacking midfielders, 1 striker
definitions.4-1-4-1: 4 defenders, 1 holding midfielder, 4 advanced midfielders, 1 striker
definitions.5-3-2: 5 defenders (3 CBs + 2 deep wingbacks), 3 midfielders, 2 strikers
definitions.AMBIGUOUS: Wingback ambiguity (3-back vs 5-back), dynamic transition, or split lines with low margin
definitions.NOT_VISIBLE: Broadcast camera zoom or pan cutting off >4 outfield players (N <= 6)

SNMOT-060.rationale: Team 0 shows 4-3-3 structure with 4 defenders, 3 central midfielders and 3 advanced players; Team 1 operates in 3-5-2 structure with 3 central defenders and wingbacks
Team 1 wingbacks drop into 5-man backline under sustained Team 0 attack
Turnover and transition phase: Team 1 shape oscillates between 3-5-2 and 5-3-2

SNMOT-061.rationale: Two compact lines of 4 for Team 0; Team 1 holding 4-3-3 shape

SNMOT-062.rationale: High line pressing 4-3-3 from Team 0 against deep 4-3-3 structure of Team 1

SNMOT-063.rationale: Team 0 shows distinct double pivot behind attacking trident (4-2-3-1); Team 1 in classic 4-4-2

SNMOT-064.rationale: Both sides set up in symmetric two-bank 4-4-2 blocks in middle third

SNMOT-065.rationale: Team 0 high 4-3-3 block; Team 1 compact 4-4-2 low block

SNMOT-066.rationale: Team 0 staggered midfield with two holding midfielders; Team 1 4-3-3

SNMOT-067.rationale: Tight box cluster and low visibility on uncalibrated camera sequence

SNMOT-068.rationale: High line 4-3-3 holding halfway against 4-4-2 defensive shape

SNMOT-069.rationale: Team 0 standard 4-3-3; Team 1 3-4-3 with wide wingbacks
Team 1 wingbacks drop deep into 5-4-1 defensive shape under sustained pressure
Transition phase with contested wingback positions

SNMOT-071.rationale: Total siege: Team 0 in high 4-3-3 against 5-3-2 low block
